title: cdk-construct-lambda-error-notification examples (all languages)
description:
Create runnable examples in packages/cdk-construct-lambda-error-notification/examples/.

Scenarios:
- minimal/ — required props (lambdaArn, lambdaFunctionName, lambdaRoleName, rateAlarmSnsTopicArn, volumeAlarmSnsTopicArn)
- comprehensive/ — all optional props: alarm tuning, SQS config, EventBridge pipe, async event config, KMS

All 5 languages. Assertion tests in test/lambda-error-notification-examples.test.ts.
